entities.name: María Conde
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Conde Alcolado is a Spanish professional basketball player for Famila Basket Schio of the Lega Basket Femminile. Conde also plays for the Spanish national team. She played two years of college basketball for the Florida State Seminoles. She was selected 27th overall by the Chicago Sky in the 2019 WNBA draft. Her WNBA rights are currently held by the Golden State Valkyries.
